title: Deliver Fruit to Monnville Food Processing Plant
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Fruit** delivered to **Monnville Food Processing Plant** (industry id 13, near tile 33,44).

A likely supplier is **Monnville Fruit Plantation** (industry id 15, near tile 26,62); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **390 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
